block.heading: 2. Add the theme block
block.product: Online Store → Themes → Customize. Switch to the Product template, click Add section, scroll to Apps, and add 3D Viewer — Product. It picks the model up from the product automatically.
block.anyPage: For any other page — home, a custom page, a blog post — pick that template from the dropdown at the top of the editor, then Add section → Apps → 3D Viewer — Any Model. Paste a Model ID from 3D Models into it; that also carries the model’s saved viewer settings. A direct .glb URL works too, but without those settings.
block.legacy: App blocks only exist in Online Store 2.0 themes. If Apps is missing from the Add section list, the template is a legacy .liquid one — use the iframe embed code on the model’s page instead.
upload.heading: 3. Upload models per product
upload.body: Open <link>Product 3D Models</link>, click a product, and upload its .glb file. Tweak any viewer setting in the same screen and watch the live preview update.
upload.formats: Accepted formats: .glb (single-file binary glTF, recommended) and .gltf. Files up to 20 MB are accepted; keep them under ~10 MB for the fastest page loads.
